goblet-squat.name: Goblet squat
goblet-squat.variationNote: A weight held against your chest

instructions.0: Hold the weight against your chest, elbows down.
instructions.1: Sit down between your heels, chest up, then stand.

bodyweight-squat.name: Bodyweight squat
bodyweight-squat.variationNote: No support, thighs down to level

instructions.0: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly out.
instructions.1: Push your hips back and bend your knees until your thighs are level with the floor.
instructions.2: Drive through your heels to stand back up.

chair-squat.name: Sit to stand
chair-squat.variationNote: Sit down on a chair and stand back up

instructions.0: Sit on the front half of a sturdy chair, feet flat.
instructions.1: Lean forward slightly and stand up without using your hands.
instructions.2: Sit back down slowly and with control.

instructions.0: Lean your back against a wall and slide down until your knees are bent at a right angle.
instructions.1: Keep your knees above your ankles and hold.

instructions.0: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat on the floor.
instructions.1: Squeeze your glutes and lift your hips until your body is straight from knees to shoulders.

instructions.0: Hold the weights in front of your thighs, knees soft.
instructions.1: Push your hips back and slide the weights down your legs, back flat.
instructions.2: Stop when you feel your hamstrings stretch, then stand tall.

instructions.0: Hinge at the hips and hike the kettlebell back between your legs.
instructions.1: Snap your hips forward to swing it to chest height, arms relaxed.
instructions.2: Let it fall back and repeat.

instructions.0: Stand with hands behind your head, knees soft.
instructions.1: Bend forward from the hips with a flat back until your torso is nearly level.

instructions.0: Step one foot back and lower until both knees are bent at about a right angle.
instructions.1: Push through the front heel to return.

instructions.0: Step forward into a lunge, back knee close to the floor.
instructions.1: Bring the back foot forward into the next lunge.

instructions.0: Place one foot on a sturdy step or bench.
instructions.1: Push through that foot to stand on top, then step down with control.

push-up.name: Push-up
push-up.variationNote: The classic, on hands and toes

instructions.0: Hands under your shoulders, body straight from head to heels.
instructions.1: Lower your chest to just above the floor, elbows at about 45 degrees.

instructions.0: Start on your hands and knees, body straight from head to knees.
instructions.1: Lower your chest towards the floor and push back up.

incline-push-up.name: Incline push-up
incline-push-up.variationNote: Hands raised on a bench or wall

instructions.0: Place your hands on a bench, table or wall, body straight.
instructions.1: Lower your chest to the edge and push away.

instructions.0: Place your hands under your chest, thumbs and index fingers touching in a diamond.
instructions.1: Body straight from head to heels, lower your chest to your hands, elbows close to your sides.

instructions.0: Feet wider than your hips, one hand under your shoulder and the other behind your back.
instructions.1: Keep your hips square to the floor and lower your chest towards your hand.
instructions.2: Push back up, then switch arms.

instructions.0: Lie on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand above your chest.
instructions.1: Lower them to the sides of your chest, then press back up.

instructions.0: Hold the dumbbells at shoulder height, core tight.
instructions.1: Press them overhead until your arms are straight, then lower.

instructions.0: Sit on the edge of a bench, hands beside your hips, then slide off.
instructions.1: Bend your elbows to lower yourself, then push back up.

instructions.0: Rest one hand and knee on a bench, back flat.
instructions.1: Pull the dumbbell to your hip, then lower it slowly.

instructions.0: Anchor the band at chest height and hold one end in each hand.
instructions.1: Pull your elbows back, squeezing your shoulder blades, then return.

instructions.0: Hold a band in front of you at shoulder height, arms straight.
instructions.1: Pull it apart until it touches your chest, then return slowly.

instructions.0: Hang from the bar, hands a bit wider than your shoulders.
instructions.1: Pull your chest towards the bar, then lower all the way down.

instructions.0: Stand with the weights at your sides, palms forward.
instructions.1: Bend your elbows to lift the weights, keeping elbows still, then lower.

instructions.0: Pick up a heavy weight in each hand.
instructions.1: Walk tall with your shoulders down until the time is up.

instructions.0: Rest on your forearms and toes, elbows under your shoulders.
instructions.1: Keep your body straight and squeeze your glutes. Breathe.

instructions.0: Lie on your side, forearm under your shoulder.
instructions.1: Lift your hips so your body is straight, and hold.

instructions.0: Lie on your back, arms up, knees bent above your hips.
instructions.1: Lower one arm and the opposite leg towards the floor, lower back pressed down.

instructions.0: Start on hands and knees.
instructions.1: Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back, hold for a breath, then return.

instructions.0: Lie on your back, knees bent, hands across your chest.
instructions.1: Curl your shoulders off the floor, then lower slowly.

instructions.0: Lie on your back and press your lower back into the floor.
instructions.1: Lift your shoulders and legs a few centimetres and hold.

instructions.0: Sit with knees bent and lean back slightly, chest up.
instructions.1: Rotate your shoulders from side to side.

instructions.0: Jump your feet apart while raising your arms overhead.
instructions.1: Jump back together and repeat at a steady pace.

instructions.0: Run on the spot, bringing your knees up to hip height.
instructions.1: Pump your arms and stay light on your feet.

instructions.0: Start in a high plank.
instructions.1: Drive your knees towards your chest one after the other, quickly.

instructions.0: Squat down and place your hands on the floor.
instructions.1: Jump your feet back to a plank, then jump them back in.
instructions.2: Stand up and jump with your arms overhead.

instructions.0: Leap sideways onto one foot, bringing the other behind you.
instructions.1: Leap back to the other side and keep going.

instructions.0: Turn the rope with your wrists and make small jumps.
instructions.1: Land softly on the balls of your feet.

walk-with-support.name: Walk with support
walk-with-support.variationNote: With a walking aid or something to hold

instructions.0: Use the walking aid your care team gave you, or walk along a wall, a rail or a counter.
instructions.1: Take small steps at your own pace. A few steps already count.
instructions.2: Keep a chair close by, and sit down whenever you need to.

gentle-walk.name: Gentle walk
gentle-walk.variationNote: Slow and short, at your own pace

instructions.0: Walk slowly on flat ground, indoors or outside, standing tall.
instructions.1: Keep a pace where you breathe easily. A minute or two is a good start.
instructions.2: Stop and rest if anything hurts, and follow your care team’s advice.

instructions.0: Walk at your everyday pace, standing tall, arms swinging freely.
instructions.1: Land on your heel and roll through to your toes.
instructions.2: On a treadmill, look ahead rather than at your feet.

brisk-walk.name: Brisk walk
brisk-walk.variationNote: Faster, you can talk but not sing

instructions.0: Walk at a pace where you can talk but not sing.
Run at a relaxed pace where you could hold a conversation.
Run at a steady pace you could hold for a while, breathing deeply.
instructions.1: Take short, light steps under your hips, shoulders relaxed.

instructions.0: Stand tall, holding a wall for balance if needed.
instructions.1: Rise onto your toes, pause, then lower slowly.

instructions.0: Start on hands and knees.
instructions.1: Breathe in and let your belly drop as you look up.
instructions.2: Breathe out and round your back towards the ceiling.

instructions.0: Lie on your side, knees bent, feet together.
instructions.1: Open your top knee like a clamshell without rolling your hips back, then close.

instructions.0: Hold your arms out to the sides.
instructions.1: Draw small circles, growing bigger, then change direction halfway.

instructions.0: Stand with hands on your hips.
instructions.1: Draw big slow circles with your hips, changing direction halfway.

instructions.0: Step into a deep lunge and place both hands inside the front foot.
instructions.1: Rotate your chest and reach the inside arm to the ceiling.
instructions.2: Return the hand to the floor and step back.

instructions.0: Kneel on one knee, other foot flat in front.
instructions.1: Tuck your pelvis and shift forward until you feel the front of the hip stretch.

instructions.0: Rest one heel on a low step, leg straight.
instructions.1: Hinge forward with a flat back until you feel a stretch behind the thigh.

instructions.0: Stand tall and hold a wall for balance.
instructions.1: Bring one heel towards your glutes and hold the ankle, knees together.

instructions.0: Kneel, sit back on your heels and fold forward.
instructions.1: Reach your arms forward and breathe slowly.

instructions.0: Place your forearm on a door frame, elbow at shoulder height.
instructions.1: Step forward gently until you feel the chest stretch.

instructions.0: Sit or stand tall, shoulders relaxed.
instructions.1: Tilt your ear towards your shoulder and hold gently.
